scope: CP39 dedicated consented post-travel reflections and anonymous experience references; schema6

environment.fixtures: Small generated isolated local databases. No user database or original photographs used.

history.failure: Additional cohort rejoin fixture restored community membership but omitted party membership removed by the existing leave trigger. Test was corrected to model explicit party rejoining; application source did not change.
history.existing_suite_result: All 58 pre-CP39 tests passed in this run.

history.note: Final targeted rerun after correcting the fixture; no claim of a single 80-pass run.

verified: All targeted travelers must separately self-report use and consent before any dedicated message extraction occurs
No existing party conversation is imported into dedicated reflections
Provider staff and unauthenticated users cannot enter traveler-only reflection operations
Future completion dates, unaccepted provider invitation and nonrepresentative creation rejected
Twelve ambiguous, trailing-negation, other-subject, private, quoted and future/hearsay examples excluded
Full-clause extraction supports explicit positive, negative and mixed aspect statements
Three distinct circles and three distinct authors required per facet; small polarity categories suppressed
Repeated contributions from a circle do not increase trip counts
Consent withdrawal and usage cancellation immediately remove reference contributions; usage cancellation clears consent
Author-only correction, stale versions rejected, source edit clears old override, source deletion clears text and results
Transient community/account/provider role or party changes latch invalidation and require new cohort epoch
Cohort refresh and completion cancellation followed by reactivation reset all confirmations and do not inherit prior epoch messages
Public summaries contain fixed anonymous text and permitted counts only
Experience reference affects relevance ties only; higher personal relevance and hard condition filters retain priority
Schema5 prior table rows preserved by additive schema6 migration, failure rollback, and reopening

review.correction: Changed partial regex matches to complete interpreted clauses directly linked to the named provider; reviewer reported original P1 resolved.
review.status: No additional major static findings reported before build.

limitations: Tests establish software behavior, not physical travel or provider use; use remains traveler self-report.
Conservative fixed local grammar is not general Japanese sentiment comprehension and does not guarantee detection of implicit sarcasm.
No external AI integration or external messages were used.
Docker migration on existing data, browser integration and deployment restart are parent-agent validations recorded separately.
Image model runtime and unrelated legacy full-suite ONNX tests are outside this targeted API regression.
